sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday looking to bounce back after consecutive defeats. Sandbach sit second in the table with 18 points from 8 games, while Cheadle Heath are among the division's strugglers in 18th place with just 5 points. This should be a straightforward opportunity for Sandbach to return to winning ways against one of the weakest sides in the division.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth, the clear league leaders on 19 points with an impressive W-W-W-W-D-W run, face a quiet weekend as they don't appear in this fixture list. Among the fixtures scheduled, Stafford Town host Alsager Town in a clash between mid-table sides—Stafford (4th, 16 points) are in better form with a recent win, while Alsager (20th, 4 points) continue to struggle. New Mills entertain Market Drayton Town in another mid-table meeting, with New Mills (6th, 14 points) slight favorites despite recent inconsistency. Bilston Town face Widnes Town in what should be a home advantage for Bilston (8th, 11 points) against bottom-placed Widnes (0 wins, 2 points). Wednesfield Community host Allscott Heath in a battle of two struggling sides near the bottom. Dawley Town welcome Brereton Social in a fixture between 14th and 15th-placed teams, both seeking to climb away from the relegation zone.
